title: Polygon from One Angle
statement: Every interior angle of a regular polygon is $140^\circ$. How many sides does the polygon have?
hints: The exterior angles of any convex polygon add up to $360^\circ$.
solution: Each exterior angle is $180^\circ - 140^\circ = 40^\circ$, and they total $360^\circ$, so there are $360/40 = 9$ sides.

solution_figures.alt: Regular nine-sided polygon. At vertex P, side QP is extended beyond P to a point X. The interior angle QPR is marked 140 degrees and the exterior angle XPR is marked 40 degrees, and the two make a straight line.
